items.title: Rudy Mazzari Interview, 1959-11-06
items.q: Pete Loderman mentioned the fact that Papa Celestin was coming to the station to do a session... sure enough, when comes this venerable old man... they sit down there, and they start going

ctx.x: Have you ever seen any colored bands around?

Mm-hmm. Not until recently, though, I'd heard about the colored bands, but somehow or other, I never seemed to have, you know, dug one until one day. And then, uh, Pete Loderman mentioned the fact that Papa Celestin was coming to the station to do a session. And so, naturally, I got all shook up because I was being my first colored band, you know. And sure enough, when comes this venerable old man, man, I'll never forget. And here comes these other cats, and they sit down there, and they start going, and that was…
